---
title: "Titanic - selectInput"
format: dashboard
server: shiny
---

```{r}
#| context: setup
library(shiny)
library(tidyverse)
library(plotly)
library(DT)
df <- read_csv("https://bryantstats.github.io/math421/data/titanic_final.csv")
```

# Plots

## {.sidebar}

```{r}
selectInput("var", "Choose a variable", choices = c("Sex", "Pclass", "Embarked"))
```

## Column

```{r}
#| title: Survival by the chosen variable
plotlyOutput("p1")
```

# Data

```{r}
#| title: Passengers
DTOutput("tbl")
```

```{r}
#| context: server
output$p1 <- renderPlotly({
  ggplotly(ggplot(df, aes(x = .data[[input$var]], fill = Survived)) + geom_bar(position = "fill"))
})
output$tbl <- renderDT(datatable(df))
```
